description: Expected results for GIFMod's official Simple_pond wizard template (USEPA/GIFMod commit 2a314750418099ca51a100d824381924ba982c91, bindata/templates/Simple_pond.wiz, unmodified): one pond with 4 constituents (DO, NH3, NOx, DOC) and 3 reactions (nitrification, aerobic and anoxic growth), 2020-01-01 to 2020-01-31. Our 4 required wizard answers are in inputs/wizard_answers.json (depth 1 m, area 100 m2); the other 8 parameters use the template defaults. There is no inflow and no initial concentration, so the pond stays at 100 m3 / 1 m head and all concentrations stay 0: the case proves the full build-model + solve + write-output path of the engine, not a water-quality result. Run with the PATCHED-FORK headless GIFMod through tools/run_gifmod_engine.py. Upstream ships no reference output; values were recorded from our own runs: two clean runs on 2026-10-06 (and a re-run of the saved .GIFMod, and the same model built from a GIFMod script) gave byte-identical wq_output and output_MB files and identical hydro_output apart from the LAI_Pond column (uninitialised memory in the engine; not checked).
engine_version: GIFMod patched fork of USEPA/GIFMod 2a31475 (headless driver + build fixes, gifmod_patches.diff), Qt 5.15.15, GCC 13.3; binary sha256 1d83043c6413b28a10cec5a26a3d203d1c86d4a2e848e0bae38830ef5b999f25
